title: Cultural Heritage and Archive Ingest
decision_boundary: May this digitized asset be ingested as an authenticated contribution to the identified collection under the recorded custodial and digitization authority?

cases.condition: recognized actor, valid delegation, and in-scope action/resource/context
recognized actor but action, resource, purpose, or context is outside delegation
authority or delegation is revoked at the evaluated decision time
required authority or revocation evidence is stale or unavailable
material metadata or authority evidence is corrected after the original decision

limitations: The result does not adjudicate ownership, cultural authority, copyright, historical truth, or authenticity of the physical object; those remain governed by the institution and relevant communities.
